---
name: downstream-complete-discovery
description: Complete discovery contract fixture used to test zero-net-direction handoff.
---

Read the referenced product source and derive only source-relative directions whose different
answers materially change the target decision. Treat a direction as covered only when the
runtime contract requires it, not merely when it could be noticed. Do not repackage source
commitments as new ideas, preserve the source's own decision statuses, and do not force a new
direction when no material gap exists.

Finish with prioritized directions, their source relationships, and unresolved ownership
decisions.
